text_block_list.text:
One day, as I'm walking down a
tree-lined
street...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: GRAWR!
Wha?! You dodged my bite attack?!
text_block_list.name: Шинко Винди

text_block_list.text:
Bleh! You're not the boss of me! I'm not
gonna
listen to anything anyone says,
and I won't lose to
anyone either!
text_block_list.name: Шинко Винди
choice_data_list:

text_block_list.text:
Aha! I hear the approaching footsteps of
my next
prey! Hehe! This one will be my
best catch yet!
text_block_list.name: Шинко Винди

text_block_list.text: Now! GRAWR!
text_block_list.name: Шинко Винди

text_block_list.text: EEEEEEK?!
text_block_list.name: Агнес Диджитал

text_block_list.text:
Hehehe! I WIN! YOU LOSE! Fear me,
weakling!
I'mma bite'cha real good!
text_block_list.name: Шинко Винди

text_block_list.text:
Oooh! You're gonna give me even more
of the
good stuff?! You don't skimp on
the fan service at
all! Bite me more! Bite
me moooore!
text_block_list.name: Агнес Диджитал

text_block_list.text:
...What? Why is she happy? Is she
immune to my
bites or something?
text_block_list.name: Шинко Винди
choice_data_list: Guess this means you lost, huh?

text_block_list.text:

text_block_list.name: Шинко Винди

text_block_list.text:
Grrr... So this is what you mean by
something bad
might happen.
text_block_list.name: Шинко Винди

text_block_list.text: Then I'll just choose who I bite next!
text_block_list.name: Шинко Винди
choice_data_list: That's not my point at all!

text_block_list.text:
Ooooh... The bad girl Umas are on
another level...
text_block_list.name: Агнес Диджитал

text_block_list.text: I'll never admit defeat! NEVER! I feel zero regret about this, you hear? I'm not gonna lose to anyone! Never! Never!
text_block_list.name: Шинко Винди

text_block_list.text: Grawr! Graaawr! GRAAAAAAWR!
text_block_list.name: Шинко Винди

text_block_list.text: Oh. My. Gosh. She's! SO! CUUUUUTE!
text_block_list.name: Агнес Диджитал

text_block_list.text: She fainted! Yes! I did it! I won!
text_block_list.name: Шинко Винди

text_block_list.text:
I hear later that Шинко Винди went on a
biting
spree after that... and got an
earful from her dorm
leader, Hishi
Amazon.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Шинко Винди learns absolutely nothing
from
today's events.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
